text:
tasha: Heads-up from todays quickstart workshop: folks hit multiple auth pitfalls across platforms. Windows PowerShell examples in dotnet-sample use $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY but our .env examples use REDWOOD_KEY. Docker quickstart uses --env-file with a .env containing REDWOOD_TOKEN. Super confusing.

ben: Yikes. We should pick one canonical env var: REDWOOD_API_KEY. Call out case-insensitivity on Windows and show PowerShell example. Also recommend NOT embedding scope into the key; use REDWOOD_SCOPE or REDWOOD_ORG/REDWOOD_PROJECT.

hiro: Parity note: .NET SDK currently prefers REDWOOD_TOKEN (historical). I'll update it to check REDWOOD_API_KEY first, then fall back to REDWOOD_TOKEN with a single deprecation warning. Will also add support to read credentials from ~/.config/redwood/credentials (cross-platform).

ci-bot: quicklinks: https://redwood.internal/quickstart,dockerfile-lint (auto)

ben: Another gotcha: Docker --env-file will silently allow typos. Suggest cred-lint CI check that scans Dockerfiles and Kubernetes manifests for unknown env names (flag REDWOOD_TOKEN/REDWOOD_KEY as deprecated). Hiro can add a kube-secret example showing how to mount as env and as file.

hiro: Will do. Also propose sample scripts for rotation: both bash and PowerShell. Example snippets: 

Linux:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/sessions -H "Authorization: rk_XXXX" | jq -r .token > .session_token
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(cat .session_token)
```

PowerShell:
```
$token = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri https://api.redwood.example/v1/sessions -Headers @{Authorization='rk_XXXX'}
Set-Content -Path .session_token -Value $token.token
$env:REDWOOD_API_KEY = Get-Content .session_token
```

tasha: Nice. Also: SDK retry behavior - please do not retry 401s. Instead expose a distinct AuthFailure that includes a short human hint like "token_mismatch_or_rotated" and an opt-in telemetry ping (one-per-process) so ops can spot mass rotations. JS currently retries 401 then masks the error.

ben: Agreed. I'll change .NET + JS to special-case 401 and surface the AuthFailure. Add a small telemetry event auth.suspected_rotation with client id and short hash so we can correlate.

hiro: Docs: I'll update quickstart with canonical env + Docker/K8s examples and a new section on rotation (scripts for sh/ps1), plus a troubleshooting snippet for Windows env quirks. Docs-bot: please point new hires to the updated page during onboarding.

docs-bot: noted. Will update onboarding checklist link when PR lands.

tasha: Action items: 1) Canonicalize REDWOOD_API_KEY + REDWOOD_SCOPE (docs) - hiro, 2) SDK changes: .NET (hiro), JS+telemetry (ben), 3) cred-lint for Docker/K8s (hiro), 4) sample rotation scripts sh/ps1 in sampleapps (tasha). Aim to land before next onboarding wave.

ben: I'll open the JS PR this afternoon.

hiro: I'll start the docs + dotnet patch now.

tasha: I'll draft the ps1/sh rotation scripts and a short README snippet for CI. Thanks!
